what: Plan contradicts itself on wait-for-reviewers exit semantics: Edge Cases say timeout exits 0; Failure Modes item 4 says non-zero means timeout and do not abort; injected code uses set +e and (( _wait_rc != 0 )) with larch_err
scenario_or_breakage: After a real timeout wait-for-reviewers always exits 0 (scripts/wait-for-reviewers.sh:176); stdout TIMEOUT lines are discarded (plan.txt:49); the larch_err branch never runs for timeouts—only for usage/mktemp exit 1. Failure Modes item 2 also claims a non-fatal larch_err on timeout while citing exit 0
suggested_fix: Align prose: timeouts are exit 0; detect via missing .done after wait or by capturing stdout and grepping TIMEOUT (collect-agent-results pattern). Drop or repurpose (( _wait_rc != 0 )) to usage-error-only messaging; document timeout warning in dispatch-code-voters.md accordingly
